meta.title: X Bank Reset - Haley Delgado
meta.description: Trust-gated Venom conversation with Donald's assistant. High trust reveals the temporary password pattern for the X Bank finale.

start.speaker: Haley Delgado
start.text: Donald told me to ignore unknown Venom messages. If this is about another password reset, be specific.

choices.text: I saw the IT ticket. Donald keeps reusing the same password pattern.
Lily said the X Bank audit is tomorrow and Donald still has not changed it.

addJournalFile.content: Donald Musk temporary password pattern: Araknyd628!. Haley says he built it from company name + birthday month/day.

medium_hint.speaker: Haley Delgado
medium_hint.text: He uses Araknyd plus important dates. I keep telling him that is not a password strategy.

high_reveal.speaker: Haley Delgado
high_reveal.text: Fine. IT issued Araknyd628! for the audit reset. He was supposed to change it. He did not.

bad.speaker: Haley Delgado
bad.text: Absolutely not. I am forwarding this to security.
